name: Caleta Lenta
request: Build an original HubSpot demo in plain HTML and CSS: a fictional liveaboard directory with a few boats, itineraries, departure dates and prices, and an inquiry form. Study the public site as a visitor would, then invent your own operator, boats, copy and layout. Use a Spanish interface. Keep the form field names in English (firstname, lastname, email, phone, message) so a HubSpot form can map them. Do not copy logos, photos, brand names or verbatim text from the site. No payments. Submitting the form only confirms in the browser.
note: Clean-room rebuild. OpenRouter model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro wrote app/ after deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash studied the page and stopped before writing. Visual likeness about 34%. Text likeness about 2%. No original logos, photos or verbatim lines are in app/.
last_reply: Four static pages for the fictional operator Caleta Lenta: home, boats, trips and an inquiry form. The form confirms in the browser and does not send data or take payment.

checks.note: Home page about 34% alike on layout and about 2% alike on text. Spanish menu labels, so the original English control names did not match. One tablet width still scrolls sideways.
